translations.web: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
translations.bsb: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
translations.kjv: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
translations.asv: Be diligent in these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy progress may be manifest unto all.
